shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls -a; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'
cat app/lib/auth.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25 && (npx next start -p 3456 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 5 && curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/admin; grep -o 'Access denied' /tmp/admin.html | head -1; grep -o 'noindex' /tmp/admin.html | head -1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/; pkill -f "next start" ; true

curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "admin=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/admin; grep -o 'Access denied' /tmp/admin.html | head -1; grep -o 'name="robots" content="noindex"' /tmp/admin.html | head -1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/
